changelog: Notes+ 20.0: resize and place pictures in your notes. Tap a picture, drag its handles to resize it, tap again to put it left, centre or right, or move it. Update Notes+ on every device you use. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 20.0 for Windows: resize and place pictures in your notes. Click one, drag its corners, put it left, centre or right, or drag it anywhere in the note.

linux.changelog: Notes+ 20.0 for Linux: resize and place pictures in your notes.

web.changelog: Notes+ on the web 20.0: resize and place pictures in your notes.
